What is slap-notes-bin?

Slap Notes is a local-first, block-based notes app that combines Notion-style blocks with Obsidian-style wiki-links, automatically building a visual graph of how your notes connect. It supports text, headings, lists, to-dos, tables, images and video blocks, daily notes, tagging, and full search. An optional built-in AI research agent can answer questions about your existing notes and draft new content back into your vault, but everything runs and stores locally otherwise.

Install slap-notes-bin on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add slap-notes-bin

Good to know

  • Your own API key from a provider such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, or OpenRouter, only if you want to use the optional AI research agent
